item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / bla ma rje la mthol lo bshags/ 'di bris dge rtsa dri med de/ nam mkhas khyab tshad sems can rnams/ bon nyid bde chen don dam dang*/ rtag du 'du 'bral med pa yi/ ma bsgrod sa chen non gyur cig kha ba can ljongs bod yul du/ bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas nas/ 'phrul ngag bden pa g.yung drung bon/ bdag gi bka' yi gdam pa 'di/ nam mkha' ji bzhin bkra shis shog/
